BiblicalUsage: Ucal is a man named in the words of Agur, beside Ithiel. In Proverbs 30:1, even unto Ithiel and Ucal.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Ucal is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
